NONE: › to take your hands off someone
把…放掉；把手從…身上移開

example: Unhand me, sir, for shame!
放開我，先生，請你自重。

NONE: A2 sad or not satisfied
哀傷的，不高興的；不滿意的

example: That's enough to make anyone unhappy.
所有人都會為此憂傷。
an unhappy marriage
不美滿的婚姻
I was very unhappy with the service.
我對服務很不滿意。

NONE: › not hurt or damaged
未受傷的；未受損害的

example: Both children escaped unharmed from the burning building.
兩個孩子從著火的大樓裡逃了出來，毫髮未傷。

NONE: B1 not good for your health, or not strong and well
不健康的；不衛生的；不良的；有害的

example: an unhealthy diet
不健康的飲食

NONE: › to not be listened to or considered
未被傾聽；未被理會

example: We complained but as usual our voices went unheard.
我們投訴了，但像往常一樣沒人理會。

NONE: › surprising or shocking because not known about or previously experienced
令人震驚的；前所未聞的，空前的

example: It was unheard-of for an unmarried couple to live together.
未婚同居，這在以前是聞所未聞的事。

NONE: C1 not improving a difficult situation
無益的，無用的
B2 not wanting to help someone, in a way that seems unfriendly
不願幫忙的

example: The instructions were badly written and unhelpful.
用法說明寫得很糟，一點兒用也沒有。
I don't need any more of your unhelpful advice!
我再也不需要你那些沒用的建議了！
The shop assistant was rude and unhelpful.
那個售貨員態度很差，不願幫忙。

NONE: › mentally ill
精神失常的，神經錯亂的

example: I sometimes think that your mother is a little unhinged.
有時我覺得你母親有點兒不太正常。

NONE: › used to describe a combination of things when it is very bad, harmful, or unpleasant
邪惡的；十分有害的；令人很不快的

before noun: 過分的；極端的；難以容忍的

NONE: › not pure or religious
不純潔的；不信宗教的

example: Religious fanatics have formed an unholy alliance with right wing groups.
宗教狂熱分子已經和右翼集團結成了邪惡的聯盟。
an unholy mess/row/noise
無法忍受的雜亂／吵鬧／噪音
He described their actions as unholy.
他形容他們的行為是不純潔的。

NONE: › not doing something too quickly; slow
不著急的；慢的

example: He has an unflustered, unhurried approach to penalty taking.
他踢點球時不慌不忙。
a pleasant and unhurried pace of life
愉悅舒緩的生活步調

NONE: › not harmed
未受傷害的；安然無恙的； 毫髮未損的
› not clean, in a way that may cause disease
不衛生的；不乾淨的
